description: You are the HR Manager at TechVenture Corp, a fast-growing software company. Q1 2025 hiring has just closed and a wave of new employees are starting next week. The inbox has been flooded with onboarding-related emails from new hires, recruiters, and the IT department. Before Monday, you need to create an 'Onboarding_Q1' folder in Local Folders with two subfolders: 'Documents_Pending' for new hires who have not yet submitted required onboarding paperwork, and 'IT_Requests' for technical setup requests from the IT department. Route each email to the correct subfolder. Add the IT Director Marcus Thompson (m.thompson@techventure-it.com) to your address book — he is your primary contact for coordinating equipment and access provisioning. Then compose a draft email reply to Marcus Thompson's most recent batch email (the Q1 new hire batch message about VPN access and security training) to confirm which new hires are starting Monday and verify that IT setup for Johnson, Kim, and Chen will be complete by their start date. Mention at least the start date or equipment readiness in your reply. Save it as a draft — do not send. Login: local account, no password needed.
